reference.format: chunks: [x, z, biome at the middle (y 64), end stone count, FNV-1a 64 of the end stone positions 'x y z;' sorted by (x, y, z), chorus block count, FNV-1a 64 of 'x y z name;' for chorus_plant and chorus_flower:age, any other block but bedrock and end_gateway (an End city)]; chorus_bases: chorus_plant blocks on end stone in the grid's interior; gateways: end_gateway blocks in the grid's interior and in gateway_chunks (fully generated chunks where end_gateway_return's rarity filter passes)
sources: the pinned dedicated server run on a new world per seed: 'execute in minecraft:the_end run forceload add' on every chunk listed, 'save-all flush', then the End's region files read back
